result:
result: The failure was a timeout in a test that the two Windows commits did not touch. It passes on this tree and `mise run verify` exits 0.

The failing test is "claude plugin validate > the built plugin passes strict validation" in `packages/integrations/claude/tests/plugin.test.ts`. It spawns the external `claude plugin validate --strict` and timed out at the 5 s default.

Reproduction: I could not reproduce the failure. On head 0948e70, `bun test` on the file passed three times in about 2 s, and the full `bun test` and an unmodified `mise run verify` each passed once. A single `claude plugin validate` takes about 0.7 s when idle.

Cause (hypothesis, not confirmed): the run in `verify-win.log` was slow enough that the spawn exceeded 5 s. The log shows 104 s for the tests; I did not measure the load behind the 104 s. Nothing in e69a3f0 or 0948e70 touches the validate path, so I am treating it as flaky rather than caused by the Windows fixes.

Fix: both validate tests now take an explicit 30 s timeout (`VALIDATE_TIMEOUT`). The assertions are unchanged, and the Windows fixes are left as they were. I also ran `bun fmt` on the file.

notes: The timeout is the only change I made, and I cannot prove it covers the original slow run. If the timeout recurs at 30 s, look at the load on the machine during the run.
